items.quote: Then the sample was tested by electron probe micro-analysis (EPMA) using the JXA-8530F Plus instrument, which was used to accurately obtain the elemental composition of each phase.
Some of the samples were ground into powder for x-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis to determine the phase composition.

The DTA test was used to determine the phase transition temperature of the samples using the STA449F3 instrument with Al2O3 crucible and a W/Re thermocouple, and the heating rate was 5  C/min under Ar (50 ml/min) atmosphere.
JSM-6490LV instrument was used for SEM detection for the samples to determine the phase distribution.

items.quote: According to the binarybased prediction of the ternary system, sixteen alloys (#1#16) were prepared, and the phase equilibria were measured in the Be-C-Si system at 750  C and 950  C. Table 1 lists the original compositions of the alloys. Beryllium (99.98% purity), Graphite (99.995% purity), and Silicon (99.995% purity) powders (supplied by USA SigmaAldrich Company) were used as starting materials.
